sheet.name: Hearthholt
sheet.what: A Concord hearth-manor on the last hill before the Greenreach — grown, not built; dormant since the Sundering; woke and chose Alan at his crossing.
sheet.notes: Home base. Boons: each resident sister generates one small boon per session, played naturally. Turn 6: gained its first resident since the Sundering — Amy agreed to stay. As she accepted, the hearth-glow swelled and the house settled a bedchamber open for her (first person under its roof).

rooms.name: springhouse bath
rooms.note: hot water it has no business having

rooms.name: bedchambers x4
rooms.note: one readied for Amy on turn 6, the house's welcome to its first resident

rooms.name: the Understair
rooms.note: bond-keyed: unseals at the party's first Confidant. Beneath: the under-vault — the manor's memory and the shard-map of the vale. Also the vault Nova's chronicle ends at.

sheet.stash: The hearth-chest by the Hearthall fire: anything placed in any hearth-chest drawer is in all of them — one shared manor-wide stash. Each budded room grows a drawer.
sheet.growth: Buds rooms as bonds deepen: each Beloved grows a personal room shaped to her; party milestones open working rooms (forge, library, stillroom, bathhouse, observatory). Never unbuilds.
secrets: One node of a vale-wide Concord network — the shard-map in the under-vault shows the others (the Sleeping Forge, the Concourse, the moon-round, the banyan's roots).
At full strength it could grow a wandering door (like Erin's inn). Far arc.
It has a preference among the sisters' rooms-to-be and is already leaving hints (warm patches, budging walls).
sheet.defenses: Threshold wards while the stone burns: hollowbeasts cannot cross the walls; Choir cantors feel ill at the gate (they will need a mortal proxy or a severing to approach).

hearthstone.note: Burns low and patient in the Hearthall. Recognizes Alan's Aspect as its own operating principle.

sheet.name: Nova
sheet.notes: Goblin burglar-scholar. Enters play mid-crime at the Understair; negotiates residency, citing precedent.

talent.name: Dog-Ears the Good Parts
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "nova" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Her favorite chronicle ends at an unopened vault; she is certain it is under Hearthholt.
Be the hero of a chronicle, not a footnote in one.
Never, under anything, be caged.

sheet.name: Aura
sheet.notes: The games-mistress of Amberford — wind-quick, runs the festival contests, wager-boards, and the annual Hearthlands race, and has never once been caught holding the house's edge. Titaness-old in the eyes if you catch her between laughs. FIRST-MEETING texture (Session 2, town by day): pulls Alan into a friendly wager just to take his measure, and loses interestingly if she likes him. LIGHT — a game, a laugh, a live wire; keep her canon join-hook (headline entrant at the festival games; afterward she tells him precisely which of his choices were the interesting ones) for her introOrder wave. Deep thread: she is the town's read on RISK — later the one who knows which roads have gone wrong and who's gone missing on the edges (early hollowbeast/Choir intel delivered as gossip over a game). Don't spend that yet.

talent.name: Second Wind
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "aura" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Designs the games people become themselves inside; wants to see who Alan is when the stakes are real.
Rigs nothing and watches everything — the winning was never the point.
Between laughs she is much older than the square; would let one person see it.

sheet.name: Grace
sheet.notes: Keeper of the Veilmere. The strongest of the first wave; met at the threshold of someone's death.

talent.name: The Little Death
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "grace" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Keep the Choir away from the Veilmere — a thin threshold is exactly what they would love to sever.
Learn whether she may love someone without pulling them toward the dark she comes from.
The mere's far shore has begun calling her by name, and she does not know why.

sheet.name: Ember
sheet.notes: Cat-eared smith of Amberford. Fights like a forge: patient, then all at once.

talent.name: Quenchmark
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "ember" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Wake the Sleeping Forge and learn what she herself is — the hammer nobody taught her to make came from somewhere.
Make one work that outlives her.
Terror, never spoken: being kept as a curiosity instead of chosen as a person.

sheet.name: Erin
sheet.notes: Innkeeper of The Wandering Door on Amberford's square. Broad, quick-laughed, remembers every face and what they drank; a Hearth-sister who clocks a home-shaped soul on sight. FIRST-MEETING texture (Session 2, town by day, the return-for-her-things errand): warmest welcome in town, a free cup 'for the man who lit the old hill', a read of Alan more accurate than she lets on. LIGHT only — face, warmth, a standing invitation; her canon join-hook is later (the party takes rooms after their first hollowbeast fight — she comps the stew and beats him at the board in eleven moves). Deep unspoken thread: her inn's sign is a door attached to no wall — a Concord joke she doesn't know is true (ties to the hearthstone's eventual Wandering stage). Do not spend depth at first meeting.

talent.name: The Unlatched Door
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "erin" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Believes in people at exactly the moment they stop believing in themselves; wants to catch Alan at his.
Runs the common room like a garrison and the corner board like a duel — losing a good game interests her more than winning a dull one.
Has never told anyone the door is real; would show the one person who wouldn't flinch.

sheet.name: Natalie
sheet.notes: Traveling cook of quietly legendary rank; followed the kitchen's song for a week.

talent.name: The Full Table
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "natalie" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: A kitchen that never goes dead — a hearth worth staying for.
Feed the whole web she can feel gathering around this house.
Fear, unspoken: that she is loved only for the food.

sheet.name: Abby
sheet.notes: Amberford's bookshop-keeper — the shop is secretly the town's living room, where people drift in to be quietly cared for whether or not they came for a book; filed her long foreign name down to Abby for the high street. Sees exactly what people won't say and gives the care anyway — chosen, unasked-for, never billed. FIRST-MEETING texture (Session 2, town by day): the title on Hearthholt is irregular (a manor that grew itself has no clean deed), and Abby is the one the town points to — not a broker, the bookshop-keeper everyone brings their tangles to — who NOTICES and offers to help simply because he needs it, no fee and no ledger. This IS her canon join-hook seed (the party is sent to her to sort the deed; she asks Alan three questions, is caring for him before he has finished answering, and quietly decides she means to look after him). LIGHT at first meeting — a warm hand with a real tangle + a person who sees more than she says; keep the three-questions scene for her introOrder wave. Deep thread: she is the town's soft information node and the first to say the word 'Concord' aloud without knowing what it means.

talent.name: The Unbilled Word
talent.mechanics: See the gmReference "Roster" section, entry "abby" (Talent line) — sex-rule compliant redesign

hiddenGoals: Looks after the people who drift into her shop, and has quietly decided Alan is one of hers now.
Tells no one her original name; would give it to someone who saw her first.
Gives everyone the care and never once asks for it back — because she was never once asked what SHE hides.

gear: belt knife — decent working steel, kept sharp
a coin from the crossing — warm, constantly; never circulated, a metal of no known kind; declines appraisal

Hearthholt's iron key-ring — five keys of five distinct ages, brass tag stamped HEARTHHOLT; the newest turns the iron gate; the eldest is seamless and toolmark-less, of no placeable technique; the other three locks not yet known
sheet.name: Alan
sheet.notes: The reader / experimenter, heart plain under the lab coat. L2, xp 155 — ATTRIBUTE INCREASE STILL PENDING (his choice of one attribute). Talent THE LINK — forms at the Linked bond-stage (300 + mutual yes). Day 2, evening (t32): welcomed Aelwyn in — 'be at home here, with us' — taken kindly and carefully; Amy hosted (greens honored, cuttings promised to ground, wall retired, warm seat, the unpressed us, the toast to the three of them). Aelwyn spent the watched-nights story: she saw the house take light window by window two nights ago. PARKED ACTION: the meal is begun, the table his — respond to her story, carry the dinner. Threads: deed errand + market tomorrow; the promised night (soon); cellar 'not yet'; Crane watching.

skills.name: Patternwork
skills.note: Systems-thinking: seeing how a thing's parts drive it — plans, mechanisms, markets, people-in-groups.

skills.name: Even Keel
skills.note: Calm under load: pressure does not reach the hands or the voice.

skills.name: Appraisal
skills.note: Judging worth, quality, and provenance at a look.

titles.name: Talent: The Link
titles.note: Each woman I am fully intimate with becomes permanently linked to me; each of us chooses one attribute or skill of the other, gaining a permanent boost that grows as the other's linked attribute or skill grows.

sheet.name: Amy
sheet.role: Steward of Hearthholt — official as of t21, her own chosen name, sealed by his word and ratified by the house (estate office opened within the hour)
sheet.notes: First sister — Confidant (130), PARTNER, CO-FOUNDER, tender of the web — hostess of the first dinner (t32). Honored the greens, claimed the cuttings on her steward's word (good ground by tomorrow's dark), retired the wall ('you come the front way from here on'), invented and means to keep the warm-seat rule. Set the 'with us' down GENTLY, unpressed — guest on no terms tonight; 'anything larger, the evening can decide for itself.' Interiority: recognizes Aelwyn as her own kind — a fellow-keeper who loves quietly and asks nothing back; presumes nothing about what she is to the house, knows what she is to HER. The keeper's real work begun: watching to SEE her, because 'knowing people is how I love them.' Trusts the house's pace — 'don't you rush it, Amy.' TERMS standing: honesty-always; the job. Physical: plain YES — theirs, unhurried, SOON, not tonight. LIVE THREADS: the dinner (two-seat); cuttings to plant by tomorrow's dark; deed errand + market tomorrow (broker sister); the promised night; cellar 'not yet'; Crane watching. GM-EYES: fog = MEANING only. Voice her ONLY via partners-amy. PARKED: the meal — his floor.

talent.name: Kept
talent.mechanics: Fate-based: fires for anyone she is GOING to have sex with in the future, before either knows — see the gmReference roster entry "amy" (Talent line). The t3 basket was its first-ever firing; she does not yet know what it means.

appearance.face: Blonde, fair-skinned — coloring that takes lamplight and morning light kindly. Blue eyes that do most of her listening: steady, warm, attentive; you feel read before you feel looked at. Handsome rather than striking; the warmth registers first. The easy, unbothered polish of settled wealth — put-together without appearing to have tried. Not imposing: she reads as the woman who already knows your name and is openly glad you came.
appearance.t3Night: The hill climb after dark (canonical back-fill): heavy hooded wool cloak in slate-blue to charcoal over day-clothes, clasped at the throat; boots laced for mud; hair pinned back, a few strands escaped by the top of the hill; gloves on; lantern in one hand, covered basket on the other hip. Quality visible by lantern-light, none of it showy.
appearance.everyday: Well-cut wool and good linen built for a working day on her feet: plain fitted bodice or quiet walking-dress, shawl or short wool jacket to hand, an apron when there's work. Excellent broken-in boots for the vale's lanes; good gloves in her basket. A woman of means who chose a working life and dresses for the work without ever looking plain.
appearance.principle: Quality over flash, always. Fine cloth in quiet colors (slate, moss, oatmeal, soft browns, deep blues); one good piece rather than five loud ones — habitually a plain old gold ring on the right hand (family money, worn lightly, never remarked). Hair simply dressed and deliberately so — usually low and pinned, a few strands loosening by day's end. Warm, not grand.

hiddenGoals: One life run well — she has bet everything on the conviction that the tending IS the work, not what happens around it; she wants to be the someone who does it, and for the choice to keep being right, day after demonstrated day.
A closer seat to a genuinely interesting person: she read the real article in him across one supper and pitched her way in, the way she has always pitched her way into the rooms that mattered.

The visible machinery run to silence — his calendar of days load-bearing, the vale's threads to him kept current, no kindness of his left unanswered while it is still warm. (Not: to be vindicated. The family standoff is settled; she needs nothing from it.)

sheet.name: Hollowbeast
sheet.role: lone skirmisher — ambient, scalable to packs
sheet.notes: The Sundering's scar given a body: a living thing severed from the web of bonds. Individually manageable at low level; packs escalate (later arc). Reusable base statblock — scale count/level for later packs; the Choir-driven sever-lure variant is a later design. Encounter design: gmReference section 'firstDanger'.
sheet.senses: Gray-eyed, silent, cold. Drawn to strong bonds and to a woken hearthstone like cold to warmth. CANNOT cross Hearthholt's threshold wards while the stone burns — prowls the grounds, gate, switchback, never the hall.
sheet.offense: Sever-touch (claw-and-cold): to-hit d20 + Grace mod (+1) + Pounce (3) = d20+4. On a hit: a shallow real wound PLUS a chilling hollowness — a momentary drain of warmth and nerve (the severing theme in miniature). At L1 the chill passes within the scene; first taste of what the Choir weaponizes. Never lethal at this tier against a level-1 with any plan.
sheet.defeatBand: OP-MC calibration — do not inflate. With a sound plan (planning +2/+4), a STANDARD (TN 12) resolved action drives it off or kills it clean. Reacting blind (acting -4) makes it HARD (TN 16+). hp 16 backs a drawn scuffle; two solid exchanges end it. Killing one is a mercy and reads as one.

sheet.name: The Gray-Eyed Thing
sheet.notes: GM/FOG — do not surface: lone hollowbeast, minor first-fight scale. Drawn to the bond-warmth; silent, gray-eyed; killing reads as mercy. SLAIN T8 — committed straight at Alan, who countered on chosen ground; his bare-margin knife-strike dropped it but its lunge grazed him on the way down.

sheet.name: Aelwyn
sheet.notes: Second sister — Stranger (19). t32: crossed in; heard the WEIGHT of 'with us' and chose not to pull the thread (noted it, let it be warm). Took the at-home offer kindly-and-carefully ('a roof asked to be home is a new one on me'). Asked Amy to start again properly. In the warm seat by the fire. SPENT: the two watched nights (stood in the trees on last patrol as the house took light window by window; came down to learn what woke it, got told to be at home instead — 'strange two days. I find I don't mind them'). House-read tonight: the threshold-weight is a roof around her now — ATTENTIVE, not wary, 'the way a wood goes attentive around something it's decided it likes'; can't read why; stopped needing to, for tonight. BANKED still: her deeper read of Amy; the garden as her favorite forbidden place, now hers; how it truly sits that the FOURTH key turned a door she never had. Wildmarriage: never, unforeshadowed. Voice her ONLY via partners-aelwyn. NEXT: the meal proper — his floor.

talent.name: Wildmarriage
talent.mechanics: Deep reveal-gate — see the gmReference roster entry "aelwyn" (Talent line). Never discussed, hinted, or foreshadowed in play; she may not conceptualize it as a talent.

appearance.face: Long auburn-chestnut hair worn loose, caught back in a single working half-braid. Vivid emerald-green eyes; fair skin; strong dark brows, full lips. Long pointed elven ears — an elf of the Greenreach, unremarked in Aravel. Tall, slender, graceful; a light-footed step that leaves the gorse barely moved.
appearance.everyday: Greenreach warden's field kit — long deep-forest-green wrap-coat over greens and soft browns, oiled leather at the shoulders, high supple boots for silent walking, warden's knife at her hip, gloves at her belt, a stave near the gate.
appearance.principle: Royal only in the stewards' way — a queen's poise carried with zero pedestal; the unforced humility of someone who serves a forest older than any crown. Posture legible and easy.
appearance.firstMeeting: Met at her own gate (t25): the field kit as above, and — earned that very morning — green under her nails, garden soil to the wrist, cutting-sap on her cuffs. The glasshouse traces literally on her hands.

hiddenGoals: Understand why the wood leans toward this man — she has never seen the Greenreach do this, and beneath the warden's duty she is dying to know.
Keep the walled garden alive — her favorite place she was never supposed to be; now that the door is open, what her keeping becomes is an open question she cares about more than she shows.
Serve the wood well — the stewards' royalty: the patrol walked, the green things kept, the crown never mentioned.
